House Third Reading roll call recording Hoffman as Y; 26 No votes, so not near-unanimous.
passages.actor_quote: HERNANDEZ M N HOFFMAN Y JERMAINE N

passages.provision_quote: Except for a form produced by the United States election assistance commission, any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship as prescribed in section 16-166, subsection F, and the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
passages.note: Chaptered text of the bill Hoffman prime-sponsored and voted for; the quoted operative text is added, not inside a deleted fence.

rows.reasoning: Hoffman was prime sponsor of HB2492 (2022) and voted Y on House Third Reading (31-26-3-0-0), and the chaptered text requires that "any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship" and that the recorder "shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship." That is the rung "Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote," clause for clause; the bill is single-subject on registration and citizenship verification and sets no polling-place photo-ID or mail-ballot ID number requirement, so the "photo ID in person and an ID number on every mail ballot" rung is not what it does. The act is from his State Representative term in the same Arizona legislature, so it is in-term under V5.
